articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas – Permian Resources Corporation (“Permian Resources” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PR) today announced that it is now rated investment grade by both S&P Global Ratings (“S&P”) and Fitch Ratings (“Fitch”), following today’s upgrade from S&P and the Company’s initial investment grade rating from Fitch in July 2025.
